_note: Empirical grade anchors committed from calibration runs. Update by re-running calibration and editing grades here. See docs/simulation_quality/quality_scoring_contract.md §11.3.
_instructions: Each pillar entry is an object {grade, score} (score = normalized_score from quality_report.json, not raw_score). Two independent checks run against it: (1) letter-grade band ±1 — if a pillar grade moves by more than one letter from the anchor, the regression test fails (anchor=B accepts A/B/C, fails D or S); (2) score tolerance — the live normalized_score must stay within max(0.05, 0.20 * |anchored_score|) of the anchored score, independent of whether the letter grade moved (catches within-band magnitude regressions the letter check alone cannot see). Either check failing is a regression. To update: re-run calibration, confirm new grades/scores, edit this file, commit.
